model.subtitle: Revenue, costs and acquisition per paying subscriber.
model.chartDetail: Cumulative contribution per new subscriber over 24 months
model.costDetail: Per paid subscriber-month, weighted by plan mix
model.breakEvenDetail: Adjust organic acquisition and monthly overhead.
model.fixedError: Enter 0–1 billion USD. Using $5,000 for now.
model.organicThreshold: Minimum organic share to cover CAC

notes.ltv: Contribution LTV = net subscription revenue minus AI and variable infrastructure costs, weighted across monthly and annual plans.
notes.cac: Paid CAC = cost per install ÷ install-to-paid conversion. Blended CAC assumes the same conversion for organic installs and zero incremental organic spend.
notes.payback: Payback is the first month cumulative contribution covers blended CAC. The model recognizes annual revenue over each 12-month term and includes one possible renewal.
notes.fixed: Operating break-even = fixed costs ÷ monthly contribution per active subscriber, rounded up. Acquisition spend is tracked separately in CAC.
notes.limits: The model excludes free-tier usage, voice, taxes, refunds and wearable integration costs. The AI estimate uses planned token volumes and rates from the report.
notes.source: Source — Fitness Companion Market Evidence & Unit Economics Report, section 4. Values are recalculated from its input assumptions.

build.title: MVP build payback
build.subtitle: Hackathon build from 10:30 to 17:50. The hourly rate is an estimate you can change.
build.hourlyError: Enter 0–1 million USD. Using $50 for now.
build.payers: New payers to recover labor in 12 months
build.recoverable: {value} per payer in first-year contribution after blended CAC, before monthly overhead.
build.unrecoverable: First-year contribution after blended CAC is {value} per payer. This acquisition mix leaves no surplus for the build.

activity.title: Product activity
activity.subtitle: Recorded app events on this browser and device.
activity.emptyDetail: Finish onboarding, start a workout or use the coach to populate this view.
activity.unavailableDetail: Allow site storage to record and view activity here.

notes.retention: Counts start when this dashboard’s event storage is enabled. The browser retains up to 4,000 recent events and shows up to 90 calendar days.
notes.workouts: Logged workouts include partial sessions. The 80% metric uses the planned set count after workout adjustments and excludes extra sessions, safety stops and seeded history.
notes.subscription: Trials in the app are demos. Prices, acquisition costs and AI expenses above are planning estimates.
notes.cohorts: The product goal is three planned workouts in the first 14 days. Cohort activation and retention require shared user IDs and server-side event collection.
